provenance.construction: Locality-constrained SAT discovery: qubits on a grid, each check anchored within radius 2.0, weight <= 6, t=3 detection CNF (d >= 4 by construction); CaDiCaL enumeration, RIS screening, MILP-exact distance confirmation. Per-code parameters in the construction field below and in the research note.
provenance.notes: Distinct construction among the [[25,5,4]] co-entries from the same campaign: different check matrix (fingerprint af05edd55bab), gate dedup passed. Checked against existing board entries at gate time; not equivalent to any of them. MILP-exact d=4 both sides (documented in the research note).

circuit.notes: Johnson-coil + 4 span flags sequential extraction (max_flags=3 per check, 6 X + 6 Z edge-colored data CX layers per round, coloring candidate 0); generated by qldpc submit (research/circuit_autogen.py, seed 0), the first of up to 6 candidates whose RIS screen at 2 rounds found nothing below d; witnesses from RIS on ker(H_dem) at twice the gate's trial budget, validated in GF(2)
